meta.nextAction: None. The audit shipped as issues #296-#302; remediation and verification live there.
meta.evidence: Every finding this audit was scoped to produce was published and closed: #296 permission-revocation invalidation, #297 out-of-process isolation, #298 secure view defaults, #299 SQLite isolation/fail-close, #300 transport caller verification, #301 sensitive-data retention, and parent #302 with the superseding 460/460 capability matrix. All seven verified CLOSED on 2026-08-07. The unchecked capability/data-flow/SQLite/transport items in check.jsonl are the audit intake list, not an outstanding acceptance gap — they were superseded by #302 rather than left undone. Do not reopen these as current vulnerabilities; they are historical fixed findings.
